1753 is a common year starting on Monday (not a leap year).  
255 days before July 1, 1753:  
Back up 6 months (to Jan 1, 1753) = 181 days (Jan–Jun except Jul).  
255 − 181 = 74 days earlier into 1752.  
1752 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian).  
From Dec 31, 1752 back 74 days:  
Dec has 31 days → back 31 to Dec 1 → 43 left.  
Nov has 30 days → back 30 to Nov 1 → 13 left.  
Oct has 31 days → back 13 days → Oct 19, 1752.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1752-10-19
